insights.title: Insights
insights.loadFailed: The roadtrip insights could not be loaded.
insights.aheadFootnote: {{km}} km of this are still ahead of you — they count towards badges once driven.

help.unit: Kilometres driven are road stages; ferry, rail, on foot and bike are shown apart. Plus nights and countries per roadtrip.
help.time: Each stage counts by the local date of the station it arrives at: before today it is driven, today it is the current one, after that planned. A roadtrip belongs to the year of its first station.
help.source: The stages and stations of your roadtrips; distances come from a recording, a computed route, a drawn line or a straight line — the “distance source” line gives the shares.
help.coverage: Undated stages count when the roadtrip is over or has no dates at all; on a roadtrip under way they stay open ({{unplaced}}).
help.exclusions: Planned stages, nights and countries count towards no badge until they are reached.

pace.title: Day stages and pace
pace.restDays_one: {{count}} day without a change of place on {{trips}} fully dated roadtrips
pace.restDays_other: {{count}} days without a change of place on {{trips}} fully dated roadtrips
pace.empty: Appears once a driven stage carries the same day at its departure and arrival station.

help.unit: A driving day: all road kilometres between two stations with the same departure and arrival day. Route corrections belong to the stage; a day only on board a ferry is no driving day.
help.source: Dated stations and stages of your roadtrips.
help.coverage: {{unstaged}} driven stages have no shared known day and are in no driving day. Days without a change of place count only on {{dated}} finished roadtrips whose stations are all dated.
help.exclusions: Planned stages and anything whose day is not known — nothing is spread out or estimated.

modes.title: Road and ferry
modes.empty: Appears with the first driven stage.

help.unit: A stage's kilometres by its mode of transport.
help.source: The mode of each stage (road, ferry, rail, on foot, bike).
help.coverage: Every stage has exactly one mode.
help.exclusions: Ferry kilometres are never kilometres you drove; only the road counts as driven.

nightStyle.title: Where the nights were slept
nightStyle.empty: Appears with the first past overnight station.

help.unit: One night. A pitch is an overnight station without a linked stay; campsite and accommodation are linked stays, by the house's kind.
help.source: Overnight stations and the stays linked to them.
help.coverage: {{unknown}} stations have no known length and are not counted as nights here.
help.exclusions: A stay linked from two stations counts once — and the same night is in the lodging statistics, never twice in one sum.

toursAlong.title: Day tours along the way
toursAlong.description: {{km}} on your own steam or guided — beside the driving, not in it
toursAlong.empty: Appears once a completed day tour starts from a roadtrip station.

help.unit: A completed day tour, its distance and its climb.
help.time: A tour is completed when it has a recording or a day before today.
help.source: Tours that start from one of the roadtrip's stations; distance from the recording, else from the route.
help.coverage: Climb only from recordings that carry it.
help.exclusions: Tour kilometres are never added to the driving, and a guided excursion is never a bus ride.

tours.title: Day tours
tours.loadFailed: The tour insights could not be loaded.

activities.title: Completed tours
activities.row_one: {{count}} tour · {{km}} km ({{kmTours}} with a distance) · {{ascent}} m climbed ({{ascentTours}} measured) · {{duration}} moving ({{movingTours}} recorded)
activities.row_other: {{count}} tours · {{km}} km ({{kmTours}} with a distance) · {{ascent}} m climbed ({{ascentTours}} measured) · {{duration}} moving ({{movingTours}} recorded)
activities.empty: Appears once a day tour is recorded or its day has passed.

help.unit: One completed day tour — hike, bike ride, guided excursion and any other activity.
help.time: A tour is completed when it has a recording or a day before today at its start. It belongs to the year of its day, or without one to the year of its first recording.
help.source: Your tours. Distance from the recording where there is one, else from the route; climb and time only from recordings.
help.coverage: {{planned}} tours are still ahead, {{undated}} have neither a day nor a recording and do not count. {{partial}} recordings stopped at the import limit — their distance is a lower bound.
help.exclusions: An unknown climb stays unknown and is never estimated from the route. Every figure says how many tours it rests on. Guided excursions count into the tour kilometres with their route — shown per activity, never as bus or driven kilometres.

moving.title: Moving and pauses
moving.empty: Appears once a recording with timestamps exists.

help.unit: Hours. Moving time is measured by the recording itself; a pause is the recorded duration minus the moving time.
help.source: Recordings of your tours (GPX, Dawarich, Strava).
help.coverage: Only tours whose every recording carries times.
help.exclusions: A planned start time or a bare total duration is not moving time and never counts here.

records.title: Personal records per activity
records.empty: Appears with the first completed tour of known distance.

help.unit: Per activity the longest tour, the largest climb and the highest known position.
help.source: Distance from a recording or the route (the source is named); climb and height only from recordings with an elevation profile.
help.coverage: A tour without an elevation profile cannot hold a height record.
help.exclusions: Planned tours and tours with neither a day nor a recording.

rhythm.title: Rhythm and areas
rhythm.empty: Appears with the first dated completed tour.

help.unit: Tours per year and month; an area is the country at the tour's starting point.
help.time: The tour's day at its start.
help.source: The coordinates of the starting point, read against country borders — never guessed from the tour's name.
help.coverage: {{withoutArea}} tours have no starting point with coordinates and are in no area.
help.exclusions: Planned tours. The list names, per country, the tour that first reached it.

links.title: Links
links.value: {{trip}} on a trip · {{roadtrip}} from a roadtrip · {{cruise}} on a cruise
links.excursions_one: Guided excursions: {{count}} completed, {{km}} km, {{planned}} planned — as tours, never as bus rides or driven kilometres.
links.excursions_other: Guided excursions: {{count}} completed, {{km}} km, {{planned}} planned — as tours, never as bus rides or driven kilometres.
links.empty: Appears with the first completed tour.

help.unit: One completed tour; a tour can belong to a trip and a roadtrip at once.
help.time: A tour is a cruise excursion when its trip holds a cruise and its day falls within it.
help.source: A tour's trip, the roadtrip station it starts from, and the trip's cruises.
help.coverage: Tours with neither a trip nor a station stand on their own. A tour can be on a trip and start from a roadtrip station at once — the figures overlap and do not add up.
help.exclusions: Tour kilometres go into no driving or bus statistic; a guided excursion is not a bus ride.
